{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check how many rows this is
n_rows = len(loyal_completed)
print(f'Number of loyal completed orders: {n_rows}')

# Check if any revenue value is 999999.99 (QA orders)
qa_orders_present = (loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).any()
print(f'QA orders present in loyal + completed subset: {qa_orders_present}')

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')"}
